d47df7f2decc0cd93f27deb58cc21c3071c9fcb8.summary: A Natto Team post, first published 2024-09-04 with a note added June 24, 2026, on scanning and reconnaissance tools used by Chinese threat actors and tools available in open source. The note cites a June 10, 2026 Black Lotus Labs report on the JDY botnet, which it says is associated with China-nexus APT groups including Volt Typhoon and is used to feed reconnaissance data into a broader Chinese state scanning infrastructure. The post text is truncated.

d4ce223008301f9d38aed51494c1d8787f9edbd5.summary: A GitHub code repository page for a basic PHP server emulator for SHATTEREDGLASS ransomware. The README describes the ransomware as previously unnamed and North Korean, and attributes it to Andariel. It lists three external sources but gives no analysis of the malware itself. Repository details: 8 stars, 0 forks, one contributor, last commit July 29, 2024. Classified as not a threat report because it is a code repository landing page, so no facts are recorded.
hedges: The README closes its source list with 'Sadly that's all.', indicating it has no further detail to offer.
